name: Pride of Spitalfields
description: The Pride of Spitalfields is a traditional British pub located just off Brick Lane, known for its authentic East End charm and community atmosphere. It offers a selection of cask ales and craft beers, including an affordable pint of Guinness. The pub features cozy seating, a roaring fire, and hosts piano nights, fostering a sense of connection among patrons. Regulars appreciate its unpretentious vibe and heritage, making it a beloved spot for locals and visitors alike.

name: Sir Alfred Hitchcock Hotel
description: The pub offers a variety of dining options including Sunday roasts, steak nights, and a special Christmas menu. The atmosphere is described as cozy, ideal for gatherings with family and friends. Reservations are recommended for the Christmas Day feast.

name: The Bull
description: The Bull is a friendly local pub in Wanstead, just 100 yards from the Tube station. It features a beer garden open until 11pm, serves fresh food five days a week, and welcomes families and dogs. The pub offers a kids' menu and dog-friendly amenities.

name: The Rookwood Village
description: The Rookwood Village is a pub located in Leytonstone, offering a wide range of drinks including craft beers and cocktails, alongside a fresh menu featuring pizzas, burgers, and salads. The pub has large screen TVs for sports and a private function room. It also provides interactive darts and ping pong for entertainment.

name: The Black Lion
description: The Black Lion Pub is located near Plaistow tube station and offers a selection of real ales, premium beers, and homemade pub food. It features a large beer garden, a function room for hire, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and sports on TV. The pub is listed in CAMRA's Good Beer Guide and has free parking for patrons.

name: Fox @ Excel
description: The Fox is a Warehouse Bar & Restaurant near ExCeL London, offering a vibrant atmosphere, versatile spaces, and a wide selection of food and drinks suitable for any occasion.

name: The Well and Bucket
description: The Well & Bucket is a pub located in Bethnal Green, London, known for its great drinks and tasty food. It is a popular spot for football and offers a lively atmosphere. The pub also features an award-winning theatre above it, offering a variety of performances.

name: Green Goose
description: The Green Goose is an East End pub with a beer garden, offering seasonal British food and drinks. It screens World Cup 2026 fixtures and hosts a weekly pub quiz with jackpots. The pub emphasizes quality ingredients in its menu, featuring traditional dishes and vegan options.

name: The Larkshall
description: Local traditional pub in Chingford with a focus on seasonal dishes and local produce. Known for its beer garden and classic British fare, including fish and chips and BBQ roasts. The pub is a venue for watching the World Cup 2026 and offers a friendly atmosphere.

name: Signature Brew Taproom and Venue
description: Signature Brew Haggerston is a dog-friendly pub located in a railway arch next to the Regent's Canal in Haggerston, East London. It serves fresh Signature Brew beers, guest beers, wine, and spirits, and hosts live music events. The venue features a dedicated space for live music photography and has an outdoor terrace.

name: The Crown
description: The Crown & Half Crown is a neighbourhood pub in Hackney Central, offering good pints and a warm welcome. It features two spaces connected by an alleyway, regular karaoke, live music nights, and a guesthouse with 13 distinctive rooms.

name: People's Park Tavern
description: The People’s Park Tavern is a Hackney pub located in Victoria Park, featuring one of the largest beer gardens in London, a BBQ kitchen, a pop-up cocktail bar, and a tap wall. It is open 7 days a week from midday until midnight on Sunday to Thursday, and until 2am on Friday and Saturday.

name: The Empress
description: The Empress is a Victorian pub and dining room in Hackney by Victoria Park, serving modern British food, good wine, and local beers and ales with a seasonal menu featuring quality produce from local suppliers.

name: The Sir John Oldcastle
description: The Sir John Oldcastle is a pub named after The Sir John Oldcastle Tavern, established by 1680, and is associated with Shakespeare's character 'Falstaff'.

name: Old Red Lion
description: The Old Red is Islington’s home for pints, pizzas, and plays, with a history dating back to 1415. It has been a gathering place for rebels, writers, and regulars for generations.

name: The Crown
description: The Crown is located in Islington, near Upper Street, known for its vintage shops and proximity to music venues like Islington Assembly Hall and O2 Islington Arena. It offers a relaxing atmosphere with nearby parks for visitors to enjoy.

name: The Library
description: A pub offering a blend of traditional and modern vibes with a menu featuring stone-baked pizzas, burgers, and wings. It provides live sports on HD screens and a bottomless brunch menu with drinks. It promotes 2-for-1 cocktails daily.

name: The Famous Royal Oak
description: The Famous Royal Oak is a family-run pub located in Muswell Hill, serving the community for over 200 years. It offers a warm welcome and friendly service, open Monday to Sunday.

name: Annie Twomeys
description: Annie Twomeys is a well-established, traditional Irish sports pub located in Southgate, London. It operates as a wet-led venue with a strong focus on drinks sales, particularly draught, and has a reputation for live sports coverage. The pub has a casual atmosphere and is community-oriented, appealing to sports fans and social groups.

name: Coach & Horses
description: A friendly and relaxed traditional pub with a fantastic selection of modern beers, real ales, rare whiskies, and natural and organic wines.

name: The Auld Shillelagh
description: The Auld Shillelagh is recognized as the 'Most authentic Irish pub in the world outside Ireland' by the Irish Times. It hosts weekly music seisiún every other Thursday and Friday at 9pm.

name: The Londesborough
description: The Londesborough is a family-owned Victorian pub in Stoke Newington, built in 1864. It offers a welcoming atmosphere with a lovely back garden, serves food and beverages, and is known for its Sunday roasts.

name: The Beehive
description: The Beehive is a Grade II listed pub in Tottenham, featuring cozy interiors and a large beer garden. It serves classic homecooked pub food, including burgers and fish and chips, and offers private hire spaces. The pub shows sports, especially football, and is popular on matchdays.

name: Whittington Stone
description: The Whittington Stone is a London pub that has recently undergone a £200,000 refurbishment, enhancing its traditional charm with new fabrics and designs. It features upgraded HDTVs, a new sound system for live sports, and bookable booths with TV screens. The pub offers a selection of local craft beers and an updated gin range, alongside a food menu with pub classics like fish and chips, burgers, and pies.

name: The Owl & Hitchhiker
description: The Owl is a lively London boozer on Holloway Road, known for great craft beers, old school arcade games, pool tables, and music.

name: The Priory
description: A fun, friendly and lively pub at the foot of Muswell Hill and Alexandra Palace, offering a selection of beers, wines, spirits, and regular events. Facilities include a pool table, darts board, and Sky Sports.

name: Simmons
description: Simmons is a late night cocktail bar known for its happy hour and vibrant atmosphere, offering a variety of cocktails, beers, and special events like Hip Hop LDN brunches and Margarita Mondays.

name: The Ice Wharf
description: The Ice Wharf is a canalside pub located on the site of the former London and North Western Stone Wharf, originally built in the 1830s to store imported ice. It features facilities like Wi-Fi, TV screens, and a licensed outside area.

name: The Prince Arthur
description: Prince Arthur is a funky London pub and Guest Accommodation featuring wood panelled walls, 60' style furnishings, and provocative art. It has a warm ambiance with dimmed lights and candles on tables. The pub offers outside seating for up to 45 people.

name: Marquis of Wellington
description: Your friendly local in London, serving a brilliant array of delicious food and drink.

name: Spit and Sawdust
description: Spit & Sawdust is a cosy, dog-friendly pub serving craft beers and bold Latin street food from Afuego Burger. It features a beer garden, sun terrace, free games, and live events.

name: The Britannia
description: Smok’d at The Britannia offers a menu influenced by BBQ from around the world, featuring smoked meats and burgers, including vegetarian and vegan options. The pub hosts a Comedy Club every Sunday and weekly Poker nights.

name: The Pommelers Rest
description: The Pommelers Rest is a pub that was formerly the Tower Bridge Hotel, named after the area's historical connection with the leather trade. The term 'pommler' dates back to 1450, referring to leather workers.

name: The Rose & Crown
description: The Rose & Crown offers an unforgettable pub experience in London Bridge with award-winning burgers, craft beers, and a selection of gin in a cosy setting. It features a welcoming atmosphere and top-quality offerings, making it a great spot for locals and visitors alike.

name: The Stage Door
description: The Stage Door is a lively backstreet pub & kitchen near Waterloo station, offering a great selection of drinks and fantastic pub grub. It features a roof garden for nice weather and relaxed dining indoors. The pub is popular on match days and has a roof terrace for enjoying the sunshine.

name: The Trinity
description: The Trinity is a beautiful, vibrant and modern pub with a traditional tudor-façade, offering modern craft beer and a cask range including London Pride and seasonal guest beers.

name: Wetherspoons - The Lion & The Unicorn
description: The Lion & The Unicorn is a pub that is open until 12:00 am. It has a history linked to the Festival of Britain in 1951, featuring a pavilion that included a cafeteria and murals depicting British history.

name: The Guildford Arms
description: The Guildford Arms is a beautiful neighbourhood pub in Greenwich known for great food, good company, and warm hospitality. It offers a welcoming atmosphere, a beer garden, and is dog-friendly. The pub is famous for its Sunday roasts and features a Robata Grill for grilled dishes.

name: Orbit Beers Brewery Tap Room
description: Orbit Beers Brewery & Taproom is located in Walworth, South London, offering a welcoming space with indoor and outdoor seating. It features regular DJs, a family-friendly atmosphere, and is dog-friendly. The kitchen, run by The Dragon Flame BBQ, serves smokehouse BBQ and Sunday roasts. The venue has nine taps of Orbit Beers and various drinks available.

name: SALT Woolwich
description: SALT was born from a vision to make great craft beer for everyone.

name: The Great Harry
description: The Great Harry is a pub located in Woolwich, known for its historical significance related to King Henry VIII and the establishment of a dockyard for the Great Harry, his flagship. The pub offers various facilities including Wi-Fi, TV screens, and step-free access.

name: Knowles of Norwood
description: Catch every moment of the World Cup live at Knowles. The best place in Norwood to watch the game with big screens and an electric atmosphere.

name: Catford Bridge Tavern
description: The pub offers a Sunday roast with options for kids to eat free with every adult roast, including veggie and vegan options.

name: The Spotted Horse
description: The Spotted Horse is a lively pub located on Putney High Street, offering a menu of fresh, seasonal British dishes and classic pub food. It features a rooftop terrace called Putney Beach Club, ideal for enjoying drinks and live sports, including Sky Sports coverage of major events. The pub is known for its Sunday roasts and is a popular spot for celebrations.

name: The Sultan
description: The Sultan is an award-winning pub located in South West London, known for its warm atmosphere and a variety of cask beers from Hop Back Brewery. It features quiz nights, cabaret, folk nights, and live music events. The pub has a walled garden and offers a small selection of food. It has received multiple CAMRA awards and is recognized for its well-kept beer and friendly staff.

name: Marquis of Westminster
description: The Marquis of Westminster is a historic gastropub in Pimlico, transformed after refurbishment. It offers a menu of classic favorites, breakfast options, expertly crafted cocktails, and a lively atmosphere. The pub also hosts a weekly quiz and provides private hire for events.

name: Fox and Hounds
description: The Fox and Hounds is a traditional end of terrace pub known for its character and personality. It caters to a diverse clientele and offers a selection of local and international drinks. The pub does not serve food, focusing instead on providing a comfortable environment for drinks and conversation.

name: The Phoenix
description: The Phoenix in Chelsea offers a mix of modern and traditional British food with daily specials. It features a selection of real ales, a curated wine list, classic cocktails, and an outdoor terrace.

name: The Duke of Clarence
description: A hidden gem in South Kensington, The Duke of Clarence is known for its live sports atmosphere with 5 big screens. It offers a menu featuring British pub food, including fish and chips and Sunday roasts. The pub is a great spot for dinner after sightseeing and is committed to providing an excellent experience for sports fans.

name: Bootsy Brogan's
description: Bootsy Brogan's is an Irish style bar in West London, offering good food and personal service during the day, and attracting a lively crowd in the evenings. It features a big screen TV showing Sky Sports.

name: Brixton Jamm
description: Brixton Jamm is a party venue in South London, central to Brixton's cultural and music scene for almost 20 years, hosting artists like Skepta and Adele. The building dates back to 1750.

name: The Warwick Arms
description: The Warwick Arms in Kensington serves food including home-cooked Indian cuisine and British pub classics. It features outside seating and offers a selection of cask ales, lagers, wines, spirits, and soft drinks.

name: Admiral Duncan
description: The Admiral Duncan features vibrant bar staff and an eclectic range of customers, hosting various event nights. They offer a limited-edition duo of cocktails with a focus on taste and style.

name: The Queen's Head
description: The Queens Head has been a free house in Soho since 1736, offering a unique pub experience without corporate constraints. It hosts live music every Sunday evening and is located near major venues like the Piccadilly Theatre.

name: The Duke of Wellington
description: The Duke of Wellington aims to create a welcoming community pub in London, offering excellent food, a variety of beers, and quality wines. After closing in March 2016, it reopened in October 2020 following extensive refurbishment.

name: Fitzrovia Belle
description: A community pub on Tottenham Court Road offering friendly service and a large food menu with classic pub favorites, daily specials, and a traditional Sunday Roast. It features two bars with a wide range of drinks and can host various events. The pub also has five boutique hotel rooms.

name: The Cow
description: The Cow is a vibrant venue known for its friendliness and cheer, specializing in Guinness and oysters. It offers prime pub fare with Northern European influences, featuring dishes like Fish stew, Bangers & Mash, and a Deluxe Seafood Platter.

name: The Pride of Paddington
description: The Pride of Paddington is a Central London pub offering a variety of drinks, food, and live sports events. They will show the Womens Six Nations Championships and FIFA World Cup 2026 on big screens, providing a lively atmosphere. Accommodation packages are available for select stays.

name: The Old City Arms
description: There's food for any occasion at your nearest pub, including small plates, sharers, grills, burgers, and pub favourites. Food options differ at each pub.

name: The Old Ship
description: The Old Ship is an iconic riverside pub in Hammersmith, offering stunning views of the Thames, seasonal British food, and a relaxed atmosphere for drinks and celebrations. It features private hire spaces for events and is known for its Sunday roasts and wedding settings.

name: The Big Chill House
description: The Big Chill House offers a menu powered by Chick'n Sours, featuring fried chicken designed for sharing and pairing with drinks. It's a place for fueling up before DJs or enjoying late-night bites.
